# CLAUDE.md — url.lucafchala.com

**This repo is an output target of the dash.** `index.html`, `url.js`, `data.json`, `_redirects`, `404.html` and `404.js` are generated by `dash.lucafchala.com/index.html` (`genUrlIndex`, `genUrlJs`, `genDataJson`, `genRedirectsFile`, `gen404Html`, `gen404Js`) and overwritten on every PURL save there.

- **To change the page, the 404 or the links:** edit the generator (or the data) in the dash repo, then commit the regenerated output here, or save / press "sincronizar" in the dash. Never hand-edit a file that starts with `generated by dash.lucafchala.com`.
- **Hand-owned here:** `_headers`, `robots.txt`, `icon.svg`, `fonts/`, `README.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.github/workflows/checks.yml`.
- **CSP** is `script-src 'self'`, so the generated HTML must never contain inline scripts or `on*=` handlers. CI checks this, plus consistency between `data.json`, `_redirects` and `index.html`.
- `/data.json` keeps `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`: lucafchala.com's 404 fetches it for suggestions, and status.lucafchala.com monitors it (it must have a non-empty `redirects` array).
- **Status monitor marker:** the page must contain the text `url.lucafchala.com`.
